query: Build an exact 3D model of the cowbell in the National Museum of American History, object 2018.0174.01, as a GLB. Here is the museum's photo and its record.
expected_behavior: Copies assets/model-template and writes spec.md with the published size (266.7 x 88.9 x 63.5 mm) and its source
Records the photo's source and CC0 licence in refs/SOURCES.md
Looks for more views (the museum's 3D scan or other photos) before deciding the structure, and lists what the one photo can't show
Runs fit_silhouette.py with params {} first and inspects target.png and overlay.png before fitting any shape
Keeps the published height and width fixed instead of fitting them
If it uses the museum's scan, uses it only to grade the model (compare_mesh.py), never to build it
